1.consolidated_definition: Espera. Interrupción o periodo de descanso antes de una nueva jornada de viaje. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El lay-over de 4 horas en JFK era otra cosa aparte y estaba planeado (El Nuevo Día, 03-29-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wait. Interruption or period of rest before a new journey of travel. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. The 4-hour layover at JFK was something else entirely and was planned (The New Day, 03-29-06)
